prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production raster background for one square item card in the Fishius mobile game.
Input image: style and composition reference ONLY. The first item card in the supplied 1844x852 mockup is x660 y291 width396 height394. Generate ONLY an empty background corresponding to that card interior, without its fish, caption, border or UI. Do not reproduce the whole mockup.
Primary request: ONE square 1024x1024 image, full bleed and completely opaque. A softly illustrated empty aquarium water backdrop matching the selected card: very pale aqua water with soft diffuse light, a few subtle small bubbles near side edges, a low warm sandy floor, and small natural rocks with kelp grouped at the two bottom corners. Restrained cream, aqua and seafoam palette, polished friendly game illustration, the same soft shading and clarity as the reference.
Composition: the center and upper 70 percent must be empty pale aqua negative space so a live fish or item sprite can be placed there by the game. Corner plants and rocks must be modest, with plants no taller than 22 percent of image height. Keep the scenery low. The bottom 16 percent of the image must be a quiet light cream caption zone, naturally blended from the sandy floor, with no objects there and no text. All rocks and plants terminate above that caption zone. At 175x175 displayed pixels the background must be quiet and legible, with no distracting texture.
Constraints: square aspect ratio, no fish, no animals, no collectible item, no large central object, no text or letters or numbers, no caption, no border, no rounded frame, no card outline, no button, no logo, no UI, no watermark, no checkerboard or transparency. No intense light shafts, no hard gradients, no oversaturated colors. Use flat front-on view and do not skew or tilt. Output the single empty background image only.
